integrity: The package separates the infinite proof from finite verification. It does not claim independent review, and it does not treat failure of targeted searches as a proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to all-one binary blocks. The proof is complete for every block length and all nonnegative arguments, while the bundled finite computation is corroborative only. The closest general subblock formula was inspected and does not state the additive inequality; an unindexed earlier corollary under different terminology remains possible.
title: Superadditivity of summatory all-one block counts
